name: Descope
summary: Descope is a developer-focused identity service for apps that sell to businesses. Single sign-on is set up per customer tenant, SCIM provisions and deprovisions users from the customer's identity provider, and roles plus fine-grained authorization decide access. A free plan covers 7,500 monthly active users, and Pro starts at $249 a month billed annually.

facts.text: Descope configures single sign-on per tenant, so each customer organization gets its own setup rather than one project-wide setting.
Descope's SCIM support lets an identity provider provision, update and deprovision users and groups in a Descope project.
Descope offers role-based authorization and fine-grained authorization that includes ReBAC and ABAC.
On the Free Forever plan there are no overages, so going past the limits requires an upgrade.

plans.name: Free Forever
plans.notes: 7,500 monthly active users and 3 SSO connections

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starts at $249 a month, billed annually. 10,000 monthly active users and 5 SSO connections. Usage-based overages apply

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Starts at $799 a month, billed annually. 25,000 monthly active users and 10 SSO connections. Usage-based overages apply

hiddenCosts: Pro and Growth charge usage-based overages above the included users and SSO connections, and the page does not publish the per-unit rates.
